readiness.jsonld_note: The homepage carries exactly 2 JSON-LD blocks: a LocalBusiness node carrying @id '#organization' (name, url, logo, description, telephone +61 1800 333 539, priceRange, PostalAddress in Scoresby VIC) and a WebSite node whose publisher points at that same '#organization' id. cannibalisation.verdict: WORSENED, and this is the most important negative finding of the scan. Today's count uses a wider and more honest slug match than the previous runs, which is part of why the numbers moved - but the direction is real: the Melbourne rendering cluster now covers 6 pages and the Melbourne builders cluster 4. GSC shows this whole Melbourne group holding positions between 12.3 and 35.9 with EXACTLY ZERO clicks across all of them. Six pages splitting the authority for one commercial intent is the most plausible on-site reason the best-placed non-brand query in the account (3d renders for builders melbourne, position 12.3) has never converted a single click. Consolidation should now outrank writing more Melbourne pages. / XAU DI, va day la phat hien tieu cuc quan trong nhat cua lan quet. Cum rendering Melbourne nay co 6 trang, cum builders Melbourne 4 trang. Ca nhom Melbourne dung o vi tri 12,3-35,9 voi DUNG BANG KHONG click. Sau trang chia nhau tham quyen cho mot y dinh thuong mai la ly do on-site hop ly nhat khien truy van non-brand tot nhat chua bao gio ra click. Gop trang gio phai uu tien hon viet them bai Melbourne.
